note: flags from an independent visual reviewer who looked at the compare images

flags.problem: Concrete-like mottling is right, but faint horizontal hairline streaks at regular intervals look like injected stamp lines not in the original; blotches read as camouflage-like at 1:1.
flags.fix: Drop or greatly reduce the horizontal line injection; check the lab-inject pass for repeated stamps and vary blotch scale.

flags.problem: Design and glow are preserved, but the STALL lettering is soft and slightly smeared at 1:1, so the flat text is not crisp.
flags.fix: Use an edge-preserving flat-art upscale (e.g. Scale2x/xBR-style) for the text, or sharpen the alpha edge, while keeping the glow.

flags.problem: Figure outline and face/tie detail are mushy and plasticky at 1:1 compared with the crisp pixel-shaded original.
flags.fix: Use an alpha-aware sharpening pass on the sprite edges and restore face/tie definition; keep the colour match.

flags.problem: A pinkish/magenta fringe is visible along the left edge of the torso and arm at 1:1, a halo from the transparent background bleeding into the colour.
flags.fix: Erode the alpha by about a pixel or fill transparent pixels with edge colour (colour-bleed/premultiply) before resizing, then re-run the gate.
